operator.pressure: Each endpoint uses the P1-05 heterogeneous density sample, its own equation-of-state stiffness and the symmetric pressure force established by P1-06.
operator.contact: The P1-06 symmetric radius-sum contact and normal damping law remains active for the immiscible profile and prevents represented phases from crossing.
operator.pressure_jump: The signed resolved jump is sigma times the mean of the two endpoint mean-curvature samples. Because P1-10 reconstructs the same oriented interface from both sides, a sphere produces sigma*2/R and endpoint reversal negates the jump.
operator.capillary_force: Each valid cross-interface pair applies the jump magnitude through endpoint rest volumes, the shared pressure gradient and normal alignment. The resulting common force is central, equal and opposite after particle-mass division.
operator.finite_policy: Capillary traction is disabled for zero surface tension, planar zero curvature, coincident particles, non-interface samples, degenerate reconstruction and non-finite pressure jumps.
operator.advertisement: No interaction capability record was added or enabled.

physical_fixtures.conservation: Unequal densities, volumes, radii, stiffness and damping with simultaneous contact, pressure and capillary traction preserve mass-weighted linear force and world-origin torque within 5e-5 of exchanged-force activity.
physical_fixtures.endpoint_reversal: Swapping endpoint populations and materials while negating oriented normals and curvatures maps every acceleration back to the same physical particle.
physical_fixtures.non_mixing_contact: A pair inside the radius sum accelerates apart with density pressure and capillarity disabled.
physical_fixtures.normal_pressure: The same pair outside the radius sum transfers repulsive normal pressure when either endpoint density exceeds rest density.
physical_fixtures.planar_and_zero_limits: Zero curvature adds exactly zero capillary contribution while pressure remains active; zero surface tension and degenerate interface flags also remove capillary traction.

young_laplace.principal_radii: Spherical fixtures use R1=R2=R and oriented endpoint curvature 2/R.
young_laplace.measurement: The pressure jump recovered from the discrete common force divided by V_first*V_second*gradient matches sigma*2/R within 2e-5 relative error for all six cases.
